WITH RECURSIVE g AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM operation o
    WHERE o.operreg >= (SELECT min(rb.botcode) FROM robot_record rb)
      AND o.operreg <= (SELECT max(rb.botcode) FROM robot_record rb)
  ) AS has
),
emap AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(gg.parent, gg.children) AS m
  FROM (SELECT o.operreg AS parent, jsonb_agg(o.operrecref) AS children
        FROM operation o
        WHERE o.operreg IS NOT NULL
          AND o.operrecref IN (SELECT rr.botcode FROM robot_record rr)
        GROUP BY o.operreg) gg
),
lv AS (
  SELECT 2 AS level, x.paths, x.names
  FROM (SELECT array_agg(o.operreg || '>' || o.operrecref) AS paths, array_agg(o.operrecref) AS names
        FROM operation o
        WHERE o.operreg IN (SELECT p.botcode FROM robot_record p)
          AND o.operrecref IN (SELECT c.botcode FROM robot_record c)
          AND o.operreg IN (SELECT o2.operrecref FROM operation o2)) x
  WHERE x.names IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.level + 1, x.paths, x.names
  FROM lv l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT array_agg(u.path || '>' || c.child) AS paths, array_agg(c.child) AS names
    FROM unnest(l.paths, l.names) AS u(path, name)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text((SELECT em.m FROM emap em) -> u.name) AS c(child)
  ) x
  WHERE x.names IS NOT NULL
)
(SELECT r.botcode AS id, r.botcode AS name, r.botcode AS path, 1 AS level
 FROM robot_record r
 WHERE NOT (SELECT g.has FROM g)
   AND (r.botcode IN (SELECT o.operrecref FROM operation o WHERE o.operrecref IS NOT NULL)) = true
 ORDER BY r.botcode)
UNION ALL
(SELECT s.id, s.name, s.path, s.level
 FROM (
   SELECT r.botcode AS id, r.botcode AS name, r.botcode AS path, 1 AS level
   FROM robot_record r
   WHERE r.botcode IN (SELECT o.operrecref FROM operation o WHERE o.operrecref IS NOT NULL)
   UNION ALL
   SELECT u.name, u.name, u.path, l.level
   FROM lv l CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(l.paths, l.names) AS u(path, name)
 ) s
 WHERE (SELECT g.has FROM g)
 ORDER BY s.path)
